title: Localized range maps to the scalar extension range
statement: For a commutative ring R, modules X,Y, a linear map f, and a prime ideal p, there exists an A-linear equivalence from the localization of Y to the scalar extension of Y whose map sends the localized range of f to the range of the scalar-extended map, where A=Localization.AtPrime p.

proof.text: Use LocalizedModule.equivTensorProduct for Y, compare its scalar structure with ModuleCat.extendScalars, and transport the range equality localized'_range_eq_range_localizedMap through this equivalence.

mathlib_searches.query: range map localized module tensor product

lean.statement:
theorem localized_range_quotient_extendScalars_aux
    (R : Type v) [CommRing R] (X Y : ModuleCat.{v} R) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (𝔭 : Ideal R) [𝔭.IsPrime] :
    ∃ e : LocalizedModule 𝔭.primeCompl (Y : Type v) ≃ₗ[Localization.AtPrime 𝔭]
      ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭))).obj Y : Type v),
      ((LinearMap.range f.hom).localized 𝔭.primeCompl).map e.toLinearMap =
        LinearMap.range ((ModuleCat.extendScalars
          (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭))).map f).hom
